name: Tinted icons
description: Rethemes tinted app icons in the tray, dock, workspaces and launcher through a lightness ramp of the theme's primary family, so every icon lands in one hue with its shading intact (method ported from Iconicul by dvrkxed). A True Monochrome switch under Theme > Tint Icons flattens them to a single colour instead. The active workspace and selected launcher entry swap to the primary colour.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Adds the theme.trueMonochromeTint key to theme.json
Changes how app icons are rendered in the bar, dock and launcher while Tint Icons is on
